messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Dashboards and alerts for the image resizer are being repointed as of the 2025-11-26 handover. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
- On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- The image resizer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-11-26, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-20. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The product catalog still relies on the image resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, having moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Atlas team for Farah. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Dune team for Farah. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- On 2026-03-17 the Atlas team decided that the image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- Dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed as of the 2025-11-24 handover. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- Dashboards and alerts for the product catalog are being repointed as of the 2025-12-19 handover. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- On 2026-04-01, ownership of the indexer transferred from the Atlas team to the Boreal team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman (Tomasz left the Atlas team on 2025-07-30 to join the Dune team). [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- As of 2025-07-30, Tomasz leaves the Atlas team and joins the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
